summary: Up to $20,000 in AI credits for 6 months, plus 3 months of engineering support.
claim_steps: Apply with a company email and provide product, funding, and launch details.
Wait for review, normally within 48 hours.
If accepted, complete the kickoff so credits can be added to the account.
